title: The Simple Method That Boosts Memory by 50%
author: Scott Young
description: Effective learning doesn't need to be complicated. Here's a simple trick that outperforms mind-maps. The post The Simple Method That Boosts Memory by 50% appeared first on Scott H Young .
summary: Sometimes the most powerful methods for learning better are also the simplest. In my latest video essay, I discuss the power of retrieval practice, and explain why students consistently underrate its effectiveness: Are Mind Maps a Waste of Time?
takeaways: Retrieve, Don’t Re-Read Despite these caveats, I think retrieval practice remains one of the most powerful learning strategies to have in your toolkit.

Another objection may be that, by focusing on concept maps made with the book open, the researchers ignored a more beneficial third alternative: that you could combine concept maps with retrieval practice and do better than both!
They found that adding retrieval practice to mind mapping yields the same boost to memory as free recall alone.
